message:
Backport fix for CVE-2011-2202

Summary: Backported fix for file path injection. The code tries to strip all path components from the
filename, ( e.g. /abc/def/foobar -> foobar)  but filnames could include a single (back)slash in the
beginning, which the code wouldn't strip due to an off-by-one error. (e.g. /vmlinuz -> /vmlinuz)

Upstream commit: http://svn.php.net/viewvc/php/php-src/branches/PHP_5_3/main/rfc1867.c?r1=312103&r2=312102&pathrev=312103

Reviewed By: @bertmaher

Differential Revision: D1303154
